performance_method: Two matched routes at three grids per model and platform, using useful updates divided by median elapsed seconds and observed twelve-run rate ranges
graph_policy: Show ESM.md and the hand-tuned baseline through absolute rates, without historical controls or normalized panels

axis_scales.CPU: Independent zero-based linear rate axes per grid
axis_scales.GPU: Independent zero-based linear rate axes per grid

figure_unit_labels: Put units in square brackets on axes, colour bars and variable-label declarations. Keep plotted values, scales and ordinary value-unit expressions unchanged.
scope: Main CPU conditions have a configured 248-core ceiling and the same actual team for both routes within each paired workload. Teams can differ across grids, with nonempty spatial owners recorded separately.
The 248-core CPU budget is a ceiling, with the same actual team in each pair.
CPU timing includes the complete coordinator and required neighbouring-cell work. GPU records use one device and retain their declared event scope and transfer exclusions.
Original elapsed-time words, source identities and accepted power and quiet policies remain in the copied source records.
Independent physical verification and exact complete-output agreement apply to the recorded inputs and configurations, without establishing performance on another architecture.
The unchanged physical figures show accepted model states rather than observations.

measurement_protocol.rate_unit: million complete interior-cell updates per second
measurement_protocol.rate_range_definition: observed minimum and maximum of useful_updates / each raw seconds value
measurement_protocol.range_interpretation: Observed extrema of twelve individual rates; these ranges are not confidence intervals.
measurement_protocol.pairing: The repeat index and original within-pair implementation order are retained.
measurement_protocol.timer_scope: One complete ordered device graph replay, including every required numerical stage and state publication
measurement_protocol.physical_update: A shallow-water update includes all three fields, both time stages and periodic boundaries. An energy-balance update includes both time stages and pole copies.
measurement_protocol.precision: Ordered binary64 arithmetic with contraction and fast-math disabled; canonical output agreement is checked outside the timer.

power_policy.benchmark_policy: The native benchmark did not set power limits or clocks. Recorded samples include automatic clock and power management.

quiet_policy.allocation: One owned exclusive node; only the current numerical step and the declared idle batch step are allowed.
quiet_policy.placement: The host driver is pinned to CPU1 and NUMA node0; the selected GPU UUID is fixed.
quiet_policy.post_sample_observation: GPU process ownership and host load are checked after each timed graph; the full observations remain in the hashed timing evidence.
quiet_policy.clock_and_power_management: The native benchmark did not set power limits or clocks. Recorded samples include automatic clock and power management.
quiet_policy.acceptance: All six retained conditions have accepted exclusive-node and quiet-sample flags; automatic clock or software power-cap events are disclosed separately.

comparison_evidence.range_definition: Observed minimum and maximum of twelve individual rates

summary.sw_intro: Matched grids, two verified solver routes.
summary.ebm_intro: Useful update rates. Longer bars are faster.
summary.caption: Point rates equal useful updates divided by median seconds. Whiskers span twelve rates. CPU workers appear inside bars. Neoverse V2 CPU timing includes coordination, while GH200 GPU timing excludes transfers.
takeaways: ESM.md CPU point rates are 90.9–97.3% of baseline.
ESM.md GPU point rates are 90.5–103.2% of baseline.
Accepted runs passed physical and exact output checks.
